job.title: General Manager - Service
job.description:
• Sector - Industrial Equipment / Engineered Products
  • Mandate - Service Growth · Commercial Excellence · Operational Delivery
  • Package scaled to experience, plus Car Allowance & Bonus

ABOUT THIS COMPANY
A growing, ISO-accredited Australian manufacturer and engineered solutions provider supporting industrial, infrastructure, construction and agricultural customers. With a strong installed base and a growing service opportunity, this business is investing in senior leadership to scale its Service Division - building the structure, performance rhythm and commercial disciplines required to grow preventative maintenance contracts, lift utilisation and margin, while strengthen customer outcomes. This is a leadership appointment for someone who can blend strategy with hands-on execution and create a service business that is both customer-centric and commercially disciplined.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Reporting directly to the CEO, the General Manager - Service holds full accountability for the commercial performance, strategic direction and operational execution of the Service Division. You will own the Service P&L, lead a multi-functional team across service delivery, service sales and service operations, and drive growth across preventative maintenance contracts, reactive service and engineered service solutions.

Your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:
  • P&L Ownership & Financial Management: Own and manage divisional revenue, margin, cost control and EBITDA contribution, including budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting
  • Service Growth Strategy: Define and execute the division’s growth plan, including target segments, pricing strategy, pipeline discipline and contract conversion from reactive to recurring revenue
  • Operational Leadership & Service Delivery: Set service delivery standards and KPIs (utilisation, SLA performance, first-time fix, rework), ensuring consistent execution, quality and customer outcomes
  • Preventative Maintenance Contract Growth: Expand the contracted maintenance base, improve retention and tenure, and drive structured account reviews to identify expansion opportunities
  • Sales Leadership & Commercial Discipline: Lead and coach service business development activity, improve win/loss performance, and strengthen proposal quality, pricing and contract terms
  • People Leadership & Capability: Build a high-performance culture across field and office teams, including capability development, performance management and workforce planning
  • Customer & Stakeholder Management: Act as the senior escalation point for key accounts, leading customer relationships and ensuring service delivery strengthens brand and retention
  • Safety, Compliance & Governance: Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure service operations meet quality and compliance expectations consistent with an ISO-accredited environment
  • Continuous Improvement: Implement practical process improvements that lift productivity, scheduling efficiency, job profitability, and customer experience across the service lifecycle
SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
This is a high-impact leadership role with genuine autonomy and the ability to shape the division’s next phase of growth. To succeed, you will bring:
  • Proven senior service leadership experience (Service Manager, Service Operations Manager, Service GM, Business Unit Manager or similar) within industrial services & equipment, mechanical or an engineered products environment
  • Demonstrated ownership of a divisional P&L (or strong commercial accountability) including margin management, budgeting and forecasting
  • Track record of growing preventative maintenance contracts / recurring revenue and improving conversion from reactive to contracted work
  • Strong operational leadership capability across field service delivery, scheduling, utilisation, SLA performance and customer outcomes.
A down-to-earth leadership style with strong communication skills and the ability to align field and office teams behind clear KPIs and standards.

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
The Company
Our client is a well-established, nationally recognised Australian organisation operating a broad network of members, suppliers and business partners. Based at their National Office in South Melbourne, they offer a collaborative and supportive environment where senior finance professionals can make a genuine and lasting contribution to business performance and strategy.

The Role
Reporting directly to the CEO, this is a senior, hands-on finance leadership role with responsibility for financial control, statutory and management reporting, compliance, cash-flow and working-capital management, payroll oversight and continuous improvement across the finance function. More than a traditional reporting role, you will partner closely with the CEO and senior leaders to turn financial information into practical commercial insight and help shape business performance and strategy.
 
Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:
  • Lead month-end and year-end close processes including journals, accruals, provisions, fixed assets, reconciliations and reporting
  • Prepare accurate and timely monthly, quarterly and annual management reports with variance analysis and Board-level commentary
  • Prepare annual statutory financial statements and manage external audit, taxation and regulatory compliance obligations
  • Maintain a robust financial control environment including accounting policies, delegated authorities, payment controls and fraud-risk prevention
  • Coordinate annual budgets, periodic forecasts and longer-term financial planning with Department Heads

  • Provide commercial analysis, scenario modelling and practical recommendations to support decision-making and margin improvement
  • Manage the quarterly member and supplier rebate cycle, including calculations, controls, reconciliations and resolution of discrepancies
  • Maintain overall oversight of payroll accuracy, controls and compliance, including PAYG, superannuation and payroll tax
  • Improve financial systems, dashboards, data integrity, automation and reporting efficiency
  • Lead, support and develop the Finance & Administration team
  • Other ad-hoc duties to support the CEO and senior leadership team

The Person
  • CA or CPA qualified (or equivalent internationally recognised accounting qualification)
  • Substantial experience in a Financial Controller, Senior Finance Manager or comparable senior finance role
  • Strong technical knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards, IFRS and statutory reporting requirements
  • Demonstrated experience managing month-end/year-end close, statutory reporting, external audit, taxation and compliance
  • Advanced budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow and working-capital management capability
  • Strong commercial analysis and financial business partnering skills; able to communicate clearly with non-financial stakeholders
